titles.title: A Christmas Murder Mystery
titles.plot: Vera Vexley is invited to spend the holidays with the Sterlings. She soon finds herself helming a murder investigation when someone is found dead on Christmas morning, putting her at odds with the quick-tempered and distraught family.

titles.title: A Deadly Adoption
titles.plot: Things go awry when an author (Will Ferrell) and his wife (Kristen Wiig) welcome a pregnant woman (Jessica Lowndes) into their home, with plans to adopt her baby.

titles.title: A Haunting in Venice
titles.plot: "A Haunting in Venice" is set in eerie, post-World War II Venice on All Hallows' Eve and is a terrifying mystery featuring the return of the celebrated sleuth, Hercule Poirot. Now retired and living in self-imposed exile in the world's most glamorous city, Poirot reluctantly attends a séance at a decaying, haunted palazzo. When one of the guests is murdered, the detective is thrust into a sinister world of shadows and secrets.

titles.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Death at the Diner
titles.original_title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Death at the Diner
titles.plot: When the owner of the diner where Aurora Teagarden works is suddenly killed, her new boyfriend becomes the primary suspect.

images.caption: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Death at the Diner (2024)

titles.title: Baaghi 2
titles.plot: A battle-hardened army officer squares off against drug lords and Russian henchmen to save his ex-lover's kidnapped daughter in the underbelly of Goa, India.

titles.title: Backgammon
titles.plot: Tensions rise when a man (Noah Silver), his girlfriend (Olivia Crocicchia) and another couple (Brittany Allen, Alex Beh) gather at a mansion for a weekend getaway.

titles.title: Bharath Enna Njan
titles.plot: To make good on a promise he made to his mother, a university graduate returns to India and becomes disillusioned by the government corruption he encounters.

titles.title: Blood Money
titles.plot: Years after a robbery, four friends reunite to split the hidden money when they encounter a psychotic killer who compels them to confront their past.

titles.title: Borderless Fog
titles.plot: A big-city detective investigates a series of gruesome murders along the Indonesia-Malaysia border, forcing her to confront ghosts from her past.

titles.title: Bullets, Brothers and Blood
titles.plot: An ex-Army Ranger searches for his brother in a lawless town controlled by a brutal crime boss. As a serial killer takes out the boss's soldiers, the ranger is mistaken for the killer. He must fight off attacks, find his brother and get out alive.

titles.title: Captain Miller
titles.plot: A renegade Captain and his unconventional outlaws execute daring heists in the 1930s and 1940s. Miller must decide whether to continue running or confront the challenges head-on.

titles.title: Cruise Ship Murder
titles.plot: A man's secret past comes to light after his wife mysteriously falls overboard on a cruise ship.

titles.title: Dangerous Ishhq
titles.plot: After her lover (Divya Dutta) is kidnapped, a woman (Karisma Kapoor) has visions of them together in the past, and she believes that -- if she can unlock a puzzle -- she will be able to rescue him.

titles.title: Deadland
titles.plot: Deadland is an elevated thriller where a US border patrol agent tries to apprehend the ghost of his father, a grave decision that will haunt him forever.

titles.title: Defile
titles.plot: A couple's secluded getaway is suddenly interrupted by a strange family who exposes them to the horrors that lie beyond the treeline.

titles.title: Dreamhaus
titles.plot: An engaged woman with a split personality disorder struggles to reconcile her life of caring domesticity with the world of her hedonistic alter ego.

titles.title: Elephant Song
titles.plot: A psychiatrist (Bruce Greenwood) is drawn into an intricate mind game with a mentally disturbed patient (Xavier Dolan) when a colleague goes missing.

titles.title: Emelie
titles.plot: A young boy tries to protect his two siblings when their new babysitter starts to reveal her psychotic nature.

titles.title: Fatal Secret
titles.plot: A successful actor's life is upended by a mysterious stalker's obsessions while a detective struggles to decipher her agenda before time runs out.

titles.title: Faultline
titles.plot: A lawyer returns to her hometown to oversee a corporate merger. While there, she stumbles across new information that calls into question her mother's involvement in a horrific murder-suicide twenty years earlier.

titles.title: Blink Twice: Official Trailer
titles.plot: A dream getaway to a billionaire's private island turns into a nightmare.

titles.title: Agent Hamilton: In The Interest Of The Nation
titles.original_title: Agent Hamilton: In The Interest Of The Nation
titles.plot: An undercover agent joins a Russian organization that plans to sell Swedish weapons to terrorists; when the deal goes awry, he must face a mercenary agency intent on assassination and war.

images.caption: Agent Hamilton: In The Interest Of The Nation (2012)

titles.title: Hidden Man
titles.plot: A young swordsman returns to solve a five-year-old murder case in 1930s China.

titles.title: Hustlers Take All
titles.plot: When an underground casino run by women recruits a brilliant young business grad, the casino's biggest rival hatches a murderous plot to stay on top.

titles.title: It's What's Inside
titles.plot: A pre-wedding reunion descends into a psychological nightmare for a group of college friends when a surprise guest arrives with a mysterious suitcase.

titles.title: Joy House
titles.plot: A luckless playboy seeks shelter in a gloomy Riviera villa owned by two wealthy American women.

titles.title: Karthik Calling Karthik
titles.plot: A man (Deepika Padukone) gets early-morning phone calls from someone claiming to be himself.

titles.title: Killer Beat
titles.plot: A female rapper's viral hit rockets her to fame but puts her life in danger when threats and odd occurrences suddenly follow her every move.

titles.title: The Man From Rome
titles.plot: Vatican intelligence operative Father Quart investigates an anonymous message sent to the pope concerning a crumbling Spanish church that "kills to defend itself." A deep conspiracy unfolds that puts Father Quart's loyalty and faith to the test.

titles.title: Mania
titles.plot: A young woman attempts to escape her narcissist mother but becomes embroiled in a far worse nightmare.

titles.title: Mission Majnu
titles.plot: Set in the 1970s, an undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan.

titles.title: Mistletoe Murders: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas
titles.original_title: Mistletoe Murders: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas
titles.plot: When an upscale restaurateur gets murdered, Emily finds herself harboring an unlikely fugitive as she tries to clear their name.

images.caption: Mistletoe Murders: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas (2025)
Mistletoe Murders: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas (2025)
Mistletoe Murders: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas (2025)

titles.title: Murder for Mortgage: Secrets on Maple Street
titles.original_title: Murder for Mortgage: Secrets on Maple Street
titles.plot: After the death of an old woman, young couple Carlee and Alex jump at the chance to buy her house at a discounted rate. However, when strange things start happening, Carlee begins to suspect that there was more to her death than meets the eye.

images.caption: Murder for Mortgage: Secrets on Maple Street (2024)

titles.title: Our Kind of Traitor
titles.plot: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

images.caption: Ewan McGregor as Perry Makepeace in "Our Kind of Traitor."

titles.title: Played & Betrayed
titles.plot: While on vacation in the U.K., a complacent husband and wife find themselves drawn toward a fiery couple who secretly have sinister intentions.

titles.title: Poirot: Death on the Nile
titles.plot: While on a holiday cruise in Egypt, the Belgian sleuth (David Suchet) investigates the murder of a rich heiress who had many enemies.

titles.title: Poirot: Lord Edgware Dies
titles.plot: Agatha Christie's Belgian sleuth, Hercule Poirot (David Suchet), solves the case of a wealthy man whose estranged wife wanted him gone.

titles.title: Poker Face
titles.plot: Set in the world of high stakes poker, Crowe stars as tech billionaire and gambler Jake Foley who gives his best friends a night they'll never forget, a chance to win more money than they've ever dreamed of. But to play, they'll have to give up the one thing they spend their lives trying to keep... their secrets. As the game unfolds, the friends will discover what is really at stake.

titles.title: Pottel
titles.plot: An underprivileged villager and a victim of caste-driven politics in his village, is forced to run away with his daughter Saraswati, but returns after undergoing a spiritual reincarnation, which in turn changes how the village receives him.

titles.title: River Wild
titles.plot: Joey (Leighton Meester) fears there could be trouble ahead after her brother Gray (Taran Killam) invites Trevor (Adam Brody), a childhood friend with a troubled past, on their whitewater rafting adventure with two tourists. Once they become stranded in raging rapids, the thrill-seeking trip quickly turns from exciting to utterly terrifying as the rafters are trapped in a desperate fight for their lives, all while someone seems intent on sabotage to ensure shocking secrets stay buried. To survive the wild river, Joey will have to face her fears, and everyone will have to develop killer instincts before they’re torn apart by deception aboard the raft, or by deadly waters wreaking havoc all around them.

titles.title: Sex Doll
titles.plot: Rupert (Ash Stymest) tries to rescue Virginie (Hafsia Herzi), a London-based French escort, from her work as a high-class call girl.

titles.title: Sirens
titles.plot: A woman (Dana Delany) believes a cop killed her ex-husband because he was black, so she plans to avenge his death.

titles.title: Standoff
titles.plot: Armed with a shotgun and one bullet, a war veteran (Thomas Jane) tries to protect a young murder witness from a ruthless assassin (Laurence Fishburne).

titles.title: Still
titles.plot: Tom Carver (Aidan Gillen) stumbles blindly towards a crossroads in his life after the death of his teenage son. He starts a feud with a teenage gang, and as it escalates, his world unravels until he is forced to make a life-changing decision.

titles.title: Sunray: Fallen Soldier
titles.plot: After dedicating his entire life to service in the armed forces, Andrew Coleman now struggles to slot back into a world he no longer recognizes. Forced to confront the death of his daughter following a fatal encounter with drugs, he becomes hell-bent on finding those responsible.

titles.title: Supercell
titles.plot: Baseball-size hail, violent winds, and churning tornadoes make supercells deadly, and when William Brody was a boy, his father -- a legendary storm-chaser -- was killed by one. Now, the family business belongs to Zane Rogers (Alec Baldwin), a reckless tour operator who sees dollar signs where others see storm clouds. When his destiny arrives in the form of one of the most powerful storms on record, William leaves his mom (Anne Heche) and home behind to team up with his father's ex-partner, Roy Cameron (Skeet Ulrich), barely surviving a tornado yet determined to chase one of nature's most terrifying creations: the bear's cage.

titles.title: Suspension of Disbelief
titles.plot: Martin (Sebastian Koch), a successful screenwriter, becomes entangled in a murder investigation with his daughter (Rebecca Night).

titles.title: Talaash
titles.plot: Inspector Surjan Singh Shekhawat (Aamir Khan) investigates a popular film star's death. Before he can solve the complicated case, he has to face his suppressed grief and deal with Rosie -- a sex worker and murderer.

images.caption: Kareena Kapoor as Rosy and Aamir Khan as Surjan Singh Sekhawat in "Talaash."
Aamir Khan as Surjan Singh Sekhawat in "Talaash."

titles.title: Targeted
titles.plot: A young woman secures a job that allows her to pursue her dangerous obsession with a crush from her past.

titles.title: The Harvest
titles.plot: A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy.

titles.title: The Landlord
titles.plot: A struggling writer stumbles upon the perfect home; she learns her landlord's friendly demeanor is masking an unnerving obsession.

titles.title: The Maid's Room
titles.plot: A live-in maid (Paula Garcés) suspects her wealthy employer's son (Philip Ettinger) has committed a horrific crime.

titles.title: The Man in the White Van
titles.original_title: The Man in the White Van
titles.plot: Inspired by a true story, "The Man in the White Van" delves into the eerie underbelly of a seemingly idyllic 1975 Florida town, and follows the harrowing experience of young Annie Williams, a spirited girl whose carefree existence is turned upside down as she becomes stalked by an ominous man in a white van.

trailer.title: The Man in the White Van: Trailer 1

titles.title: The Marriage Pass
titles.plot: A former playboy is granted a pass from his marriage and is entangled in a deadly web of deception.

titles.title: The Perfect In-Laws
titles.plot: After a series of mysterious events, a woman starts to suspect there may be more to her father-in-law's death than just a simple accident.

titles.title: The Shallows
titles.plot: Still reeling from the loss of her mother, medical student Nancy Adams (Blake Lively) travels to a secluded beach for some much-needed solace. Despite the danger of surfing alone, Nancy decides to soak up the sun and hit the waves. Suddenly, a great white shark attacks, forcing her to swim to a giant rock for safety. Left injured and stranded 200 yards from shore, the frightened young woman must fight for her life as the deadly predator circles her in its feeding ground.

titles.title: The Sintern
titles.plot: A young woman hellbent on revenge takes a job as an intern at a megachurch to expose a corrupt pastor with dark secrets.

titles.title: Tomorrow You're Gone
titles.plot: A mysterious woman (Michelle Monaghan) helps an ex-convict (Stephen Dorff) after a planned murder goes wrong.

titles.title: Very Merry Mystery
titles.plot: Beloved beauty shop owner Bea attends a Christmas murder mystery party at the mansion of a hard-nosed businesswoman, but the evening takes a shocking turn when the host goes missing and a ransom note is found.

titles.title: What Happens in Miami
titles.plot: Spring break becomes trouble in paradise for a group of best friends when one of their own goes missing, and they are the prime suspects.
